profile.name: PC散热与灯效控制设备
profile.name_en: PC Cooling and Lighting Control Device
profile.description: 用于台式机或测试平台的硬件控制设备，可管理风扇或水泵转速、RGB灯光，以及部分机型的显示屏内容，并读取设备状态与标识信息。常见于一体式水冷、风扇集线器或机箱控制器。
profile.description_en: A hardware control device used in desktop PCs or test benches to manage fan or pump speed, RGB lighting, and on some models integrated display content, while reporting device status and identification information. Common examples include AIO liquid coolers, fan hubs, and case controllers.
